Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: ToolPreset

   A named set of default parameter values for a GUI tool (key, display title, params, hint text).


   .. py:attribute:: key
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: title
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: params
      :type:  dict[str, Any]


   .. py:attribute:: hint
      :type:  str
      :value: ''



.. py:data:: _PRESETS
   :type:  dict[str, dict[str, ToolPreset]]

.. py:function:: presets_for_tool(tool_id: str) -> tuple[ToolPreset, Ellipsis]

   All registered presets for *tool_id*, empty if the tool has none.


.. py:function:: preset_choices_for_tool(tool_id: str) -> tuple[str, Ellipsis]

   Display titles of *tool_id*'s presets, for populating a combo box.


.. py:function:: preset_key_from_title(tool_id: str, title: str) -> str

   Resolve a preset's display *title* back to its key for *tool_id*; ``"custom"`` if unmatched.


.. py:function:: get_preset(tool_id: str, key: str) -> ToolPreset | None

   Look up the preset registered under *key* for *tool_id*, or ``None``.


.. py:function:: apply_preset_to_panel(panel: Any, tool_id: str, preset_key: str) -> None

   Copy preset values onto magicgui tool_panel widgets when they exist.


.. py:function:: label_centroid_voxel(mask: numpy.ndarray, label_id: int) -> tuple[int, int, int]

   Voxel index of the largest connected component for *label_id*.


.. py:function:: cursor_voxel_indices(viewer: Any, layer: Any) -> tuple[int, int, int]

   Map Napari cursor position to voxel indices for *layer*.
